publicationLimit: Raw member image files and full private DOM stay local. Safe controls show only unsaved/save states and need their associated action log to establish the sequence.
triageStatus: P3 unsaved local-draft UX candidate; duplicate review against existing #1411 pending; no new issue number assigned

evidenceBoundaries.behaviorSource: Recorded UI action/state observations in runs. Page Back without an observed warning and reentry with six empty positions are recorded at all three widths.
evidenceBoundaries.imageScope: One tablet unsaved-footer crop, one desktop enabled manual-Save crop, and one desktop post-reload disabled-Saved crop. No mobile image is published. Images alone do not show all Back/reentry transitions or the full pitch.
evidenceBoundaries.persistence: No server Save or Submit was activated. Final desktop reload retains the initial six-empty-slot baseline. The finding concerns unsaved local drafting effort only, not loss of saved server data.
evidenceBoundaries.navigation: Observed page Back, not a general claim about every browser/OS navigation path.

limitations: Exact serving page SHA was not directly observed.

publicationReview.privacy: All three exact cropped images were pixel-reviewed. Only aggregate court/waiting counts, unsaved guidance, and Save-state controls are visible. No member names, profile IDs, birth dates, contact details, credentials, or member-list payload are included.
publicationReview.sourceScope: Only local-tactics-three-width-summary.json and its three safe control files were used. Original URLs, timestamps, source clip values, and recorded viewport/state observations are preserved. Local file paths were replaced with filenames.
